summary: Alvotech filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of 22,666,667 ordinary shares at $3.75 per share, with an over-allotment option of 3,400,000 shares. Concurrently, a private placement of 17,826,666 shares was agreed upon at the same price, grossing ~$66.85M. Joint book-runners are BofA, Jefferies, and Evercore. This is a capital-raising transaction via a shelf registration, not a special situation event. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No premium, strategic catalyst, or structural change is involved. What to watch: pricing risk and underwriter exercise of the option.
